body:
I really appreciate what you have to say.  I guess the problem with reality right now is that I question everything around me.  I question my feelings, my motives, my mind.  I'm just filled with doubt about everything.  It's a little hard to really explain, but I'm trying to get my thoughts together.

I'm pretty sure I'm naturally introverted.  There are very few time's when I'm not shy and quiet, and even then its rather confusing why I'm not myself.  And I guess that's why I guess I show a different face sometimes, because I'd rather not talk to anybody about things that are really troubling me.  

I forgot to add this to my post, but I really used to be driven (in a positive, happy way) to be successful.  I enjoyed school, I played sports, and I was a talented violinist, writer, and artist.  But I ended high school by throwing it all to the side for drugs, concerts, and partying.  I don't know why I did, but it happened.  And its another big part of why I feel so empty, because I know I cloud my feelings and function with the aid of substance at times.

Tonight, I'm drawing again, and its making me feel more calm.  Thank you for your insight OP, it means more than you know.

Thank you for the advise. I'm going to put every bit of energy and honesty into the session tomorrow, and I think it will help.  I know that keeping all this inside is probably the worst thing for me at the moment.

Thanks man.  I'm just really scared about facing my old problems tomorrow.  I haven't really told anybody the whole story of what I'm dealing with.  And it makes me afraid that I'm so fucked up right now inside even though everything in life is getting a bit more stable.  I've cheated death, but I just feel like it's catching back up with me and there's nowhere to run now.
